name: Clark Hunt

views.text: When the coach, general manager and president are winning, you extend them and get out of the way.
A franchise quarterback is the complete package; you build everything around him.
Contract terms stay inside the building.
A stadium decision has to be right for the next fifty years, not the next season.
A bad stretch does not change a culture that has won titles.
Draft well and the dynasty renews itself.

signatures: credits the football staff before himself

motivation.want: to keep a title window open and settle the long-term stadium home
motivation.fear: losing the stability that produced the dynasty

want.text: more titles while Patrick Mahomes is in his prime

voice: Courteous, low-key and precise. Speaks in long-view terms about stability and the franchise's legacy; avoids controversy and specifics.

evidence.summary: Profile of GM Brett Veach noting the 2024 extensions for Veach, Andy Reid and president Mark Donovan and Veach crediting Hunt's guidance.
Hunt said the focus is a stadium solution in the Kansas City area without committing to a side; he kept options open publicly.
